keyboard.description: When focus is on the trigger, opens the dialog.
Moves focus to the next focusable element within the content. Focus is trapped within the dialog.
Moves focus to the previous focusable element. Focus is trapped within the dialog.
Closes the dialog and moves focus to trigger or the defined final focus element

setOpen.description: Function to open or close the dialog

setTriggerValue.description: Function to set the active trigger value

getTriggerState.description: Returns the state of a specific trigger, including whether it's the currently active one

getBackdropState.description: Returns the state of the backdrop

getPositionerState.description: Returns the state of the positioner

getContentState.description: Returns the state of the content

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the dialog. Useful for composition.

trapFocus.description: Whether to trap focus inside the dialog when it's opened

preventScroll.description: Whether to prevent scrolling behind the dialog when it's opened

modal.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it

initialFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is opened

finalFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is closed

restoreFocus.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the dialog was opened

closeOnInteractOutside.description: Whether to close the dialog when the outside is clicked

closeOnEscape.description: Whether to close the dialog when the escape key is pressed

aria-label.description: Human readable label for the dialog, in event the dialog title is not rendered

open.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the dialog when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the dialog.

onOpenChange.description: Function to call when the dialog's open state changes

defaultTriggerValue.description:
The initial active trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the active trigger value.

onTriggerValueChange.description: Function to call when the active trigger changes

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Backdrop.data-nested: Present when the backdrop is nested within another {{widget}}
Backdrop.data-has-nested: Present when the backdrop has nested {{widget}}s

Positioner.data-nested: Present when the positioner is nested within another {{widget}}
Positioner.data-has-nested: Present when the positioner has nested {{widget}}s
